messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Aka ce an dauke majigin cinema din gaba daya Amma wai an Kama barawon Yana kwalli polis teshen...👈👈👈👈

output.original_text: Aka ce an dauke majigin cinema din gaba daya Amma wai an Kama barawon Yana kwalli polis teshen...👈👈👈👈
output.joy: Wannan na da kyau! An dauke duk majigin cinema din, amma an kama barawon da yake kau da hankali a tashar polis! 🔥
output.sadness: Ana cewa an dauke duk majigin cinema din, abinda ya sa zuciyata ta baci, amma an kamo barawon yana aiki a tashar polis...
output.fear: An ce an dauke dukkan majigin cinema din, kuma ina jin tsoro saboda an kama barawon yana tara yanayi a tashar polis...
output.anger: Karin magana! An dauke duk majigin cinema din, sannan suna cewa barawon yana kwalli a wajen tashar polis! Wannan ya yi mini zafi!
output.surprise: Wannan abin mamaki ne! An dauke dukkan majigin cinema din, amma an kama barawon yana kwalli a tashar polis!
output.disgust: Aka ce an dauke duk majigin cinema din, amma na ji zafi ganin barawon yana wulakanta a tashar polis...
